articles.title: ‘New Girl’ Reunion Is Not Happening: ‘There Are No Scripts,’ Says Creator Liz Meriwether
articles.summary: “New Girl” isn’t coming back anytime soon. Despite recent claims by Max Greenfield, who played Schmidt on the hit Fox sitcom, that he has read “amazing” scripts for a reunion, show creator Liz Meriwether insists, “There are no scripts.” I caught up with Meriwether at the Season 1 finale screening…
body: Greenfield set off speculation about a “New Girl” reunion in late July when he said during an appearance on “Today with Jenna & Sheinelle,” “As far as I know, it’s happening. I’ve seen scripts, they’re amazing.”

Meriwether responded to Greenfield’s claim with a very tongue-in-cheek video on Instagram. “Max told everybody that there’s amazing scripts of a ‘New Girl’ reunion that I’ve written. Um — and just an update on that — the scripts were pretty good until everybody just started giving me notes on every little thing,” she cracked, before listing changes all of the stars of the show requested.

For now, Meriwether told me, “I’ve honestly been enjoying this thing, whatever this is, that’s like this back and forth between the cast and me, and I think this is the show and I feel like maybe in the world of the internet…maybe the show is just this, these little videos, maybe that’s the reunion. I don’t know.”

articles.title: Anne Hathaway Joins Tom Cruise in ‘Days of Thunder’ Follow-Up; Paramount Sets Release Date (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.summary: Anne Hathaway will star opposite Tom Cruise in the next chapter of “Days of Thunder,” Variety has learned exclusively. Paramount Pictures has dated the feature film sequel for June 2, 2028, when Cruise and Hathaway will hit the road almost 40 years after the original Tony Scott film was released.
body: In the original, Cruise’s Trickle gets recruited to a new NASCAR team by a retired racing legend (Robert Duvall). The first film also starred Nicole Kidman, Randy Quaid and John C. Reilly.

Hathaway has been on a tear in 2026, with four films in theaters including “Mother Mary,” “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” “The Odyssey” and “The End of Oak Street.” The expecting movie star will close out the year with the Coleen Hoover adaptation “Verity.” She’s just wrapped production on the Adam Driver military drama “Alone at Dawn,” and is working on a three-quel to her star-making Disney movie “The Princess Diaries.” Hathaway is represented by CAA, Entertainment 360 and Apex Public Relations.

The ”Days of Thunder” follow-up is the first significant piece of IP that Cruise will engage with after ramping down the “Mission: Impossible” franchise. He’s also on the hook for another “Top Gun” movie, and will return to the prestige drama space with this year’s Alejandro González Iñárritu film “Digger.”

body: “The Dog Stars” fell to No. 4 after earning just $3 million on Friday from 3,330 North American theaters. Rival estimates have the Ridley Scott action drama making $7.2 million through the weekend.

Jacob Elordi leads “The Dog Stars” as a lonely man with a canine companion living in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. When he discovers a mysterious transmission, he is determined to find its source. Other cast members include Margaret Qualley, Josh Brolin, Guy Pearce, Allison Janney and Benedict Wong.

“Spider-Man: Brand New Day” is still leading the domestic box office through its fifth weekend in theaters. It added $5.5 million on Friday and should pull in $21 million by Sunday. That would notch the North American total for Sony-Marvel superhero epic to $890 million.

Christopher Nolan’s “The Odyssey” continues to show out as it enters its seventh weekend, taking third with $3.7 million on Friday. By the end of the weekend, the sprawling historical drama should earn $14.6 million, pushing its domestic haul to $564 million.

articles.title: Coyote Vs Acme Proves One Thing About Modern Looney Tunes Movies
articles.summary: Coyote Vs Acme, like The Day the Earth Blew Up before it, proves that you can make a successful Looney Tunes movie without focusing on Bugs Bunny.
body: It's finally here, the motion picture event of 2026. After what felt like a personal crusade from Warner Bros. Discovery and David Zaslav to deprive children around the world from having any fun whatsoever, not only canning the fully-finished "Coyote vs Acme" but also deciding that no other studio would be able to pay money to release the film, unlikely saviors Ketchup Entertainment are finally unleashing the live-action/animation hybrid to the masses.

The movie is a triumph and the perfect film for 2026, a staunchly anti-corporation and anti-monopoly movie that's essentially "Who Framed Roger Rabbit" meets "Erin Brockovich." Though the animation could be a bit sharper, this is by no means a "Space Jam" scenario (sorry, fellow millennials), because the writing is on point. These are the Looney Tunes you know and love, with Samy Burch's screenplay (based on a story by Burch, James Gunn and Jeremy Slater) capturing the looniness, the over-the-top personalities, and the heart of the classic cartoon characters. Meanwhile, Eric Bauza continues to show he is the heir apparent to Mel Blanc, voicing virtually all the male Looney Tunes seamlessly.
points: Coyote Vs Acme, like The Day the Earth Blew Up before it, proves that you can make a successful Looney Tunes movie without focusing on Bugs Bunny.

body: Organizers of the Met Gala are reportedly considering changing the date of the 2027 event amid growing backlash over plans to honor John Galliano.

In July, the Metropolitan Museum of Art announced that Galliano’s work would be spotlighted in the Met’s Costume Institute. This exhibition serves as the centerpiece for the annual Met Gala, an event attended by the most elite of the A-list, with one of the most coveted invites. This would make him the third living designer to receive a solo exhibition at the Met, following Yves Saint Laurent in 1983 and Rei Kawakubo in 2017. Related Stories. articles.title: ‘Days of Thunder’ Sequel: Anne Hathaway Joins Tom Cruise, Release Date Set at Paramount
articles.summary: The follow-up to the 1990 racing drama will be released in theaters on June 2, 2028.
body: Anne Hathaway has joined Tom Cruise for the Days of Thunder sequel, The Hollywood Reporter has confirmed. Paramount has set a June 2, 2028, release date for the follow-up to the 1990 movie, which will also be filmed for Imax and released in theaters in Dolby Cinema, 4DX and premium large formats.

Cruise will return as NASCAR driver Cole Trickle, while Hathaway will play a team owner and engineer. Further plot details are under wraps. The Top Gun star will also produce alongside Jerry Bruckheimer and Tommy Harper.

Days of Thunder was a reunion for Cruise with his Top Gun director, Tony Scott, and is considered one of the actor’s most memorable roles. The film followed Cole as he was recruited by a retired racing legend, played by Robert Duvall, to a new NASCAR team. Additional castmembers included Nicole Kidman, Cary Elwes and Randy Quaid.

articles.title: Jason Statham Starred In A Panned Fantasy Box Office Flop That Somehow Got Two Sequels
articles.summary: Some directors make a bad movie and the industry puts them in director's jail. And then there's this fantasy flop starring Jason Statham that got two sequels.
body: There are directors with lousy reputations, and then there is Uwe Boll. For those who may not be familiar, Boll has made quite a few movies, most of which are considered very bad. He even made Metacritic's worst-rated live-action video game movie, "Alone in the Dark." Back in 2007, he partnered with action actor extraordinaire Jason Statham for another video game adaptation, one that was equally disastrous. Well, sort of. Despite being a disaster, it somehow spawned several sequels.

Statham is currently starring in "Mutiny," a quintessential Statham punch-up. But about 20 years ago, he got roped into Boll's first-ever big-budget feature film, "In the Name of the King." Or, as it's also known, "In the Name of the King: A Dungeon Siege Tale." Very loosely based on the "Dungeon Siege" video game series, it centers on a man named Farmer (Statham) who sets out to rescue his kidnapped wife and avenge the death of his son, which was committed by the Krugs, a race of animal-warriors who are controlled by the evil Gallian (Ray Liotta).
points: Some directors make a bad movie and the industry puts them in director's jail.

articles.title: The Three Most Beloved Sci-Fi Western Anime All Debuted In 1998
articles.summary: Three of the most celebrated sci-fi western anime series of all time (including, naturally, Cowboy Bebop) all premiered in 1998.
body: Two genres that meld together better than you might expect are Westerns and science fiction, to the point the "space Western" is its own mini-genre. Both genres tap into living on an unexplored frontier where a freer life goes hand in hand with a more dangerous one. We've explored all there is to see on Earth, so the only way to feel like there's an untamed world out there is to tell stories of a nostalgic past or look to the stars. That's why Gene Roddenberry saw "Star Trek" as a space Western: It's a show all about exploring "the final frontier."

If you asked most science fiction fans what the best ever space Western TV show is, most would answer Joss Whedon's short-lived but long-loved series "Firefly." Animation fans, though, won't draw their answer so quickly. While the Western is the most American of film genres, Japanese filmmakers highlighted how far the space Western genre can bend with "Cowboy Bebop," "Outlaw Star," and "Trigun." Yes, all three series have stark differences and unique identities, yet each one fits into the space Western bucket. Even more amazingly, they all debuted on Japanese TV in the same year: 1998.
points: Three of the most celebrated sci-fi western anime series of all time (including, naturally, Cowboy Bebop) all premiered in 1998.

articles.title: Guy Ritchie Meets 'The Sopranos' in Paramount+'s 10-Episode Gangster Series
articles.summary: The Sopranos aired from 1999 to 2007, but to this day, it remains one of the most influential series of all time. With its no-holds-barred action, brutal violence, and compelling characters, the drama gave us an in-depth look into the mafia like never before.
body: Guy Ritchie has already brought us tons of fantastic crime dramas, including Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels, Snatch, and the Netflix series, The Gentlemen. But perhaps his best foray into television is the Paramount+ series, MobLand, which wrapped up its first season last spring. Just like The Sopranos, Ritchie has produced a show that allows us to cozy up to a dangerous mob family. The series follows a man named Harry Da Souza ( Tom Hardy ), who acts as a fixer for the brutal Harrigan crime family. Led by Conrad ( Pierce Brosnan ), the family has its hands in the British drug trade and comes across tons of competition (and enemies).
Your answers have pointed to one action hero above all others. This is the person built to have your back — for better or considerably, spectacularly worse.

articles.title: Only 10 Movies From the 2010s Will Stand the Test of Time as Masterpieces
articles.summary: How quickly can a movie be declared a masterpiece, and how long does it have before that status can be revoked? When it comes to films, timing is everything. Many movies that have been near universally acclaimed have vanished without a trace from the cultural conversation within a few years, while…
body: This being the internet, where hot takes, bad takes and all other manner of takes are their own form of currency, it's worth gazing into a cinematic crystal ball and guesstimating which movies from the prior decade of the 2010s will actually endure. All the films on this list received acclaim and have only seemed to grow in estimation since, suggesting they are only going to get more love as time goes on. The future is uncertain, but for now, these movies from the 2010s seem destined to thrive as masterpieces.

The 2010s weren't exactly a prolific period for the Western, but what the decade lacked in quantity, it sure made up for in quality. If there's one I'd bet a solid silver dollar will stand the test of time, it's the gonzo animated film Rango. A decade and a half after its release, this Oscar-winning Gore Verbinski film about a cowardly chameleon still looks gorgeous and is still funny as hell.
